name: R023-pain-split-substitute
why: Challenge 7 (Pain Split and Substitute sets only meet there). The player's Dusclops (set 378, Pain Split in slot 2) uses Pain Split every turn on the opponent's lead Golem (set 498: Focus Punch, Substitute, Double Team, Rest). Golem cannot touch the Ghost: the AI scores Focus Punch -10 (no effect), Rest -3 above half HP, so it picks between Substitute and Double Team (ties broken at random; Double Team gets +3 only at 90% HP or more, and the first Pain Split drops Golem to about 86%). Golem is faster, so on the turn it makes a Substitute, Dusclops's Pain Split that same turn hits the Substitute and painsplitdmgcalc jumps to the failure script; a Substitute made earlier stays up for the next Pain Split. Pain Split never rolls accuracy, so Double Team does not matter.
